bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit +€60k but cash +€16k — customers owed €138k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €192k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €118k paid to tax authority; €2k paid for stock or other timing items.

Aug 2026: Profit +€36k but cash €108k — customers owed €154k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €1k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €92k paid to tax authority; €82k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Sep 2026: Profit +€34k but cash €1,037k — customers owed €1,328k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €15k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €100k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €361k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit +€43k but cash +€33k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €62k, collecting more than was invoiced; €18k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €193k paid to tax authority; €118k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€44k but cash €171k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €171k, collecting more than was invoiced; €379k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €97k paid to tax authority; €68k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €27k but cash €33k — customers owed €645k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €312k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €123k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €468k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).
